Sam K: Anyone catch that last-second OT? I screamed so loud my cat submitted my waiver by accident.
Priya M: OMG same. my dog celebrated and knocked my lineup into chaos.
Marco: Highlight clip incoming in #sports-highlights. that three-pointer was ridiculous.
Maya: Who wants to bet lunch this week that Marco's team collapses in the semifinals? :chart_with_downwards_trend:
Owen: I accept. Loser buys lunch and brings iced coffee. stakes are high.
Sam K: @Owen recorded. Also can someone check if waivers go through before midnight? I need to reverse the accidental claim if possible.
leaguebot: Reminder: Waiver processing at 23:59 UTC. No manual reversals after processing; please contact Commissioner for exceptions.
Priya M: Commissioner is out until Wednesday, FYI. Maybe @Sam K DM the owner you accidentally claimed from? good faith negotiation helps.
Marco: I'm hosting a quick 10-min bracket trivia after standup tomorrow. small prizes = glory.
Maya: Trivia? count me in. I will trade my pride for snacks.
Owen: Lunch bet accepted. Also can we put a scoreboard at the office kitchen TV? would be fun during games.
Sam K: Love the scoreboard idea. Facilities, can we get a small HDMI streamer set up?
Priya M: I'll ping facilities. Also reminder: keep spoiler etiquette in #random until midnight for teammates in other time zones.
Marco: Agreed. Post highlights in #sports-highlights only.
Maya: Poll: Who wants midday watch party Thursday? leaguebot: created poll "Thursday midday watch party?" options: Yes / No. Voting open 24h.
leaguebot: votes recorded: Maya yes, Marco yes, Priya M yes.
Owen: Late addition: if my team wins the semi I'm claiming the office playlist for a week. Heads up.
Sam K: Challenge accepted. You're going to need more than playlist energy, @Owen.
Priya M: End of thread. Good luck, small wagers and big heart attacks.
